g.id: History and significance / full workbook text

path.id: Taiyuan paper cutting dates back over 2,500 years, with references found in the Records of the Grand Historian. It carries on the artistic style of the Qin and Han dynasties. In May 2021, it was added to the National Intangible Cultural Heritage list.
It is one of Taiyuan's most representative folk arts with over 2,500 years of history, deeply connected to local customs and everyday life.

A beloved folk art used in festivals, weddings, housewarmings, temple fairs, and daily life. The style is realistic yet flexible, with smooth and vivid lines. It is often passed down through families, with the Guo and Wang families being the main hereditary lines, now in their fifth generation.
